t: Fortress Trade 2.5Ltr White Gloss Water-Based Trim Paint delivers a high-sheen finish for interior and exterior wood and metal surfaces. This durable gloss paint is ideal for skirting boards, door frames, and metal railings, offering excellent coverage of 12m²/Ltr. Its advanced water-based formulation is touch-dry in 2-4 hours and recoatable in just 4 hours, ensuring quick project turnaround. The paint is washable, low odour, non-yellowing, and provides a tough, long-lasting finish. With a trace VOC level, it is a practical choice for various professional and DIY applications.
